name: Jujutsu Kaisen — Season 3: Culling Game Overdrive
blurb: A violent Culling Game colony: ultraviolet seals, cyan cursed-energy particles, orbital spectrum pressure and crystalline keystrokes.
direction: Culling Game ensemble with chromatic glitches, moving barrier bands, and cursed-energy pressure.

name: Frieren Season 2 — Aureole Reverie
blurb: An ancient blue-gold night of comets, mana traces and soft traveling light, with a floating ribbon spectrum and quiet creamy keys.
direction: A serene ultra-wide journey pan with drifting light and a quiet blue-gold atmosphere.

name: Witch Hat Atelier — Silver Ink Coven
blurb: Bone-white ink circles turn over amethyst parchment, with drafting-line motion, a framed visualizer and ceremonial Topre keys.
direction: Portrait parchment composition animated with rotating drafting circles and living silver ink.

name: Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War — Blood War Zenith
blurb: A black-white-red battlefield cut by crossing blades, hard full-width instruments, split spectrum motion and sharp blue-switch strikes.
direction: Stark monochrome Soul Reaper poster cut by moving red blades and inversion flashes.

name: Mushoku Tensei — Mana Labyrinth
blurb: A deep cyan-jade mana labyrinth with rotating spell geometry, luminous islands, an orbital visualizer and soft magic-key resonance.
direction: Cinematic interior parallax with expanding cyan-jade mana rings.

name: Goodbye, Lara — Abyssal Farewell
blurb: Blue-pink abyssal waves, rising memory bubbles and a breathing ribbon spectrum create a beautiful melancholy ocean interface.
direction: Lake and mermaid imagery animated through water-refraction strips and rising bubbles.

name: You and I Are Polar Opposites — Season 2: Chromatic Polarity
blurb: Hot pink and electric cyan opposites collide in animated polarity waves, playful glass islands and bright tactile Panda key sounds.
direction: A playful manga-cover split screen moving in opposing pink and cyan directions.

name: Ghost in the Shell — Cyberbrain Rain
blurb: Emerald cyberbrain grids and cobalt data rain drive a hard tactical bar, neural scan visualizer and clean Tealios key response.
direction: Cyber portrait with scanlines, block glitches, and falling neural data.

name: Daemons of the Shadow Realm — Gate of Night
blurb: A new twin-gate composition—violet night against solar gold, bound by a moving central seam and mirrored daemon telemetry.
direction: The official key visual becomes two opposed moving gates divided by a gold seam.

name: JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure: Steel Ball Run — Golden Spin
blurb: Golden-ratio spirals rotate through royal violet desert night, with racing islands, an infinite-spin visualizer and hard switch cadence.
direction: Johnny, Gyro, and Lucy framed by an animated golden-ratio spiral.

name: Hell’s Paradise — Season 2: Tao Inferno
blurb: A completely new Tao inferno: rotating scarlet lotus fire, toxic jade life-force, aggressive full bar and brutal Panda strikes.
direction: Shinsenkyo artwork transformed into a living red-and-jade floral kaleidoscope.

name: Dorohedoro — Season 2: Hole Smoke Ritual
blurb: Acid-green and purple smoke bands crawl through industrial black, with grimy fit-bar instrumentation and heavy brown-switch clacks.
direction: A gritty character scene distorted by drifting smoke and chromatic corruption.

name: One Piece — Elbaph Arc: Giants’ Dawn
blurb: A colossal world-tree reaches into a moving amber dawn, with ocean-blue runes, heroic notch bar and festival-bright motion.
direction: Elbaph battle art with a rising world-tree camera and rotating sky runes.

name: Nippon Sangoku — Ashen Shogunate
blurb: Ash-black maps, bone banners and a red imperial seal form a severe command rice with framed telemetry and disciplined Topre keys.
direction: Manga-cover imagery treated as a severe moving ink map with a pulsing red seal.

name: Black Torch — Mononoke Ember
blurb: A black-flame shinobi rice with orange ember trails, violet spirit rings, fast island motion and precise Tealios attack clicks.
direction: Character key art surrounded by rising embers, spirit particles, and black-flame strokes.
